scope: Private geometry is offline diagnosis only. Relative drift is measured, not a grasp certificate. Reference thresholds are descriptive, not new success gates. Surface identity and unrecorded intended offsets remain unknown.

calculations.policy_reason: Compensate the visible shaft tilt from the previous contact, recenter its tip, and retry a shallow insertion.
Regrasp the shifted frame and align its measured tip above the stand opening before another controlled descent.
Bring the larger hole above the exposed hook tip and tilt its plane to match the measured direction of the hook's raised lip.
Rotate the measured stem downward and transport its insertion end above the stand opening.
Turn the tool upright with its larger ring above the grip, then place the ring just outside and above the hook tip.
